entries.title: [tool:pwsh] EPERM: operation not permitted, rename
entries.trigger: `pnpm install` on Windows while another process holds a file under `node_modules`
entries.fix:
Close whatever holds the directory (an editor, a running dev server, real-time antivirus scanning), then re-run `pnpm install`.
If it keeps failing, use `pnpm install --config.node-linker=hoisted`.
entries.notes: Seed entry. Seen most often under paths with non-ASCII characters.

entries.title: [llm] CONTEXT_OVERFLOW: the request does not fit the context window
entries.trigger: A long session, or a tool result that pasted a large file into the conversation
entries.raw_message: CONTEXT_OVERFLOW: the request exceeds the model's context window
entries.notes: Seed entry. The message text is illustrative; providers word this error differently.

entries.title: [llm] NO_ADAPTER: no adapter for the configured provider
entries.trigger: Starting a session right after editing the provider in a profile
entries.raw_message: NO_ADAPTER: no adapter is registered for the configured provider
entries.fix:
The provider name in the profile matches no installed adapter, almost always because of a typo.
Compare it with the names of the adapters that are actually installed, correct the spelling, and restart.
entries.notes: Seed entry. The message text is illustrative.
